# Sunfinity Technology Solutions

> Simplifying the complex — data, sales, and talent for the AI-driven world.

Sunfinity is a technology services firm headquartered in Pune, India, with presence in Mumbai and New Delhi. Founded by veterans from Wipro, HPE, Dell EMC, UiPath, Commvault, FIS, and TCS. Contact: sales@sunfinity.tech | +91 98193 32161 | H-18 Runals Deepmala, Pimple Saudagar, Pune 411027, India. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sunfintech/

## Services

- [Advanced Data Services](https://sunfinity.tech/advanced-data-services): End-to-end database consulting, implementation, migration, and managed services. Core expertise in PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elastic, EDB Postgres, and YugabyteDB.
- [Business Intelligence & Analytics](https://sunfinity.tech/business-intelligence-and-analytics): Tableau-powered visualization, MIS automation, and analytics managed services.
- [UpSkilling Services](https://sunfinity.tech/upskilling-services): Technical sales / pre-sales training via Sellers' Interpersonal Quotient (SIQ), in partnership with Mastering Technical Sales (USA).
- [Staffing Services](https://sunfinity.tech/staffing-services): Talent acquisition and contract staffing for database, cloud, infrastructure, analytics, and solution engineering.

## Company

- [Home](https://sunfinity.tech/): Positioned around three pillars — complex data, business analytics, and technical sales.
- [About](https://sunfinity.tech/about): Leadership includes Anshuman Rai (Co-Founder & CBO), Sriraman R (Partner & Practice Lead), and Ajay Agrawal (Partner & Practice Head).
- [Partnerships](https://sunfinity.tech/partnerships): EDB Postgres AI, Yugabyte DB, Salesforce / Tableau, Elastic, Mastering Technical Sales, Cloudera.
- [Careers](https://sunfinity.tech/careers): Open roles at Sunfinity.
